user_story: As a registered user, I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my account.

positive.title: Successful login with valid email and password
steps: Enter a registered email in the email field
Enter the correct password in the password field
positive.expected_result: The user is logged in and redirected to their account homepage.

negative.title: Unsuccessful login with invalid email format
steps: Enter an unregistered email or a non-email string in the email field
Enter any password in the password field
negative.expected_result: Login fails, and an error message is displayed indicating an invalid email format.

negative.title: Unsuccessful login with correct email but incorrect password
steps: Enter a registered email in the email field
Enter an incorrect password in the password field
negative.expected_result: Login fails, and an error message is displayed indicating the email or password is incorrect.

negative.title: Unsuccessful login with empty email and password fields
negative.expected_result: Login fails, and error messages are displayed indicating that both fields are required.

edge.title: Login with email having leading and trailing spaces
steps: Enter a registered email with leading and trailing spaces in the email field
Enter the correct password in the password field
edge.expected_result: The system trims the spaces and successfully logs the user in, redirecting them to their account homepage.
